gaps.reason: both authoritative Table 3 rows are not implemented and have no codes, so entirely inoperable Rule 2 is omitted with source numbering preserved

gaps.valueSet: Rule 6: four-fold Coxiella burnetii phase II IgG antibody titer rise in paired specimens
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks this rule not operational; SEM_V1 cannot compare paired specimens, the 21-180 day interval, or fold changes, so Rule 6 is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Rules 7-8 and 10-11: Coxiella burnetii phase I/II IgG antibody titer thresholds
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the 1:128 and 1:32 titer rules inoperable because of eICR result formatting; SEM_V1 has no numeric/titer comparison, so all four rules are omitted

gaps.valueSet: Rule 9: clinical findings or observations plus contact with a laboratory-confirmed Q fever case
gaps.reason: the authoritative source marks the logic set inoperable because the epidemiologic-link criterion is not implemented; SEM_V1 also lacks numeric temperature thresholds and several clinical value sets have no codes, so Rule 9 is omitted rather than allowing clinical findings alone to report

gaps.valueSet: Rules 13-15: laboratory test orders and code-less test-panel value sets
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 lab evidence does not distinguish orders from completed observations, so coded order-name alternatives use labTestInValueSet; all three authoritative panel value sets have no codes and their branches are omitted
the authoritative snapshot marks these reporter types not implemented in RCKMS; SEM_V1 does not carry reporter-source or death-certificate cause/contributing-condition evidence
